info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_Update Loan Details API
info.description: The Update Loan Details API allows financial institutions to modify existing loan information for a specific loan identified by its unique loanId. This operation is crucial for maintaining accurate and up-to-date records in the lending process, ensuring that all loan data reflects current terms, conditions, and statuses. It is typically used by loan officers and administrators who require the ability to manage loan details efficiently. By using this API, institutions can streamline their loan management workflows, improving overall service delivery to customers.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific loan using its unique identifier. Ensure that the request body contains the updated information in the required format to process the request successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to update the details of an existing loan identified by the loan ID, LOAN-2026-001245. Ensure that the necessary fields for updating the loan are provided in the JSON format.

200.description: Request executed successfully and the resource has been updated.

500.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
